summary: Session-4 testing of the Weekly Chase Board (backend + frontend). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_chase_board.py (12 pytest cases) — chase-board shape/fields/sorting, opp_fh_rate populated, _id leak, limit/window/league filters, auth enforcement, /api/best-bets 'chase' card, paste-odds -> EV recalculation (with mongo cleanup), and /api/picks regression. All 12 passed. Full suite: 93 passed / 1 failed (pre-existing eng-nl zero-shots data gap). Verified via API: within_days 3/7/14 -> 16/155/216 candidates, limit honoured, board sorted by chase_score desc, opp_fh_rate non-zero on 25/25 rows (mean 58.7%), market_key always '{venue}_over_{line-0.5}'. Frontend (Playwright, cookie session): /scanner renders chase-board with 25 chase-rows showing team vs/@ opponent, Won/g, Opp conc, Opp FH %, Hits x/5, Proj lambda, Line (X+), Fair, and 'add odds' (expected, placeholders cleared); filter-window 3d -> 16 rows, 14d -> 25, filter-limit Top 15 -> 15 rows, filter-scope 'Eerste Divisie' -> 7 rows; best-top-chase card renders and navigates to /fixture/:id. Fixture detail quick-paste: target=home + '4.5 2.20 / 5.5 3.10' saved and recalculated (home_over_4.5 +67.8% @2.2, home_over_5.5 +100.2% @3.1, 'EV recalculated' toast); 'Palmeiras 5+ 3.50' correctly routed to the AWAY table as Over 4.5 @3.5 without touching home odds; the chase board row for that fixture then showed chase-ev '+100.2% @ 3.1'. Picks page shows won/lost/pending + 70% strike rate tile with 7 manual picks and no Profit/ROI. Test odds pasted during testing were deleted afterwards (state restored).

minor.issue: All teams have shots=0 for eng-nl (National League) — v2 lambda shots-intent factor degrades to neutral for that league. Pre-existing data-ingest gap, not a session-4 regression.
Odds are merged only; there is no way to clear/delete a wrongly pasted price (posting {} or a value <=1 is silently ignored). Users cannot undo a bad paste from the UI.

issues: The strike-rate tile renders only the sub-text '7/10 settled' — RecordChip hides `label` whenever `sub` is present, so the word 'Strike rate' never appears next to the 70% figure (data-testid=picks-strike-rate exists). Consider showing both label and sub.

action_items: Optional: backfill shots data for eng-nl (only league with all-zero shots).
Optional: add label to the Picks strike-rate tile so the 70% figure is self-explanatory.
Optional: allow clearing a pasted odds value (delete market key when input is emptied).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1439 lines — consider splitting routers (picks/scanner/chase/explain) into modules.
_chase_board rebuilds the full teams collection + odds on every request with no caching; at 27 leagues it is fine (<1s) but will not scale linearly if leagues grow.
GET /api/fixtures/{id} does not expose the raw odds map (only inside model.markets); harmless but worth noting for API consumers/tests.

success_rate.backend: 99% (93/94; the 1 failure is a pre-existing eng-nl data gap)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily pasted odds on fixture 9e1fe55c (Fluminense vs Palmeiras) to verify EV recalculation; odds doc deleted afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stale expectations in older test files were updated this iteration: backend_test.py now expects 27 leagues and best-bets keys {chase,streak,mismatch}, scanner tests tolerate 0 rows (placeholder odds cleared by design), test_model_v2 sources a fixture from /api/chase-board instead of /api/scanner, and test_explain accepts cached True on first call (cache key is derived server-side from stats, so identical payloads stay cached). If you paste odds during testing, delete the db.odds doc afterwards to keep the chase board in its 'add odds' baseline state.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found in the chase-board feature. The single failing regression test (eng-nl all-zero shots) stems from the data ingest for the National League not populating shot counts on team.real_matches.
